investment_strategy: Barbell the AI cycle with a quality tilt: anchor the portfolio in lower-volatility, highly diversified AI platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) and add a capped satellite in the key picks-and-shovels beneficiary (NVIDIA). Given VIX ~19.6 and 10Y yields ~4.23% (a choppy, rate-sensitive tape) and a recent Nasdaq pullback, we overweight resilient, cash-generative platforms with strong analyst support and consistent execution, while sizing high-beta exposure carefully. News flow favors enterprise AI adoption, semis supply chains, and data center power build-out, but also flags regulatory and export-control risks—so concentration is managed and position sizes reflect risk.
